Cilantro Tea
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, February 11, 2010 - 6:34pm

Ingredients




teaspoon Coriander seed
1 tablespoon Fresh cilantro, (coriander)
1 cup Water
1 Rosehip tea bag or 1 tsp. loose rosehip tea
1 tablespoon Cranberry juice cocktail

Preparation

1 Crush coriander and place in a 2-cup glass measure. Add cilantro and tea; set aside. Bring water to a boil; pour over tea mixture. Gently crush cilantro against sides of the glass measure; cover and steep 10 minutes. 2 Strain tea; add juice and serve. 3 Yield: 1 serving (about 15 calories per 1 cup serving).
